about.body: A lightweight format converter. The core stays small and capabilities extend on demand: images use the system ImageIO, text and structured data are handled by our own engines, and heavy formats are left to optional modules.
about.engines_none: No engine currently needs a package — everything installed is built in.
about.license_body: The app itself is MIT. The image engine uses the ImageIO built into macOS (via sips); no third-party codecs are distributed with the app. Optional av / 3d / office modules carry their own license notes and run as separate processes, so their licenses do not affect the core.
